description: Lead — new demat account and brokerage pricing

messages.content: Hi, I want to open a demat account this week. What are your brokerage charges?
Happy to help! Are you a new investor or transferring holdings?
New investor. Looking to start investing in equity and want to start a SIP.

description: Retention — fee dispute then close account threat

messages.content: I've asked three times about this unexplained fee. This is unacceptable.
Sorry for the trouble — let me check your ledger.
If this isn't fixed today I'm closing my account and moving my money elsewhere.
Your competitor is cheaper and actually replies.

description: Upsell — existing equity customer wants advisory and LAS

messages.content: I already trade equity with you — do you offer a premium advisory plan?
Yes, we have a wealth manager tier. What are you looking for?
Also want a portfolio review. Interested in adding mutual funds and loan against shares.

description: None — statement PDF request

messages.content: Can you share my last month's statement PDF?
Sure — I've emailed the statement to your registered address.

description: Lead — wealth plan evaluation for parents

messages.content: We're evaluating wealth plans for my parents. Can someone walk us through pricing and onboarding?
Absolutely. I can book a call with an advisor tomorrow.

description: Retention — support delays and account closure

messages.content: Not happy with support delays. Thinking of leaving.
We apologize — can we make this right?
I want to close account if the next reply takes another day.

description: Lead — online signup and first-time investor pricing

messages.content: Can I sign up for a new account online? Interested in your pricing for first-time investors.
Yes — I can share the fee schedule and start onboarding.

description: Lead — same-product pro plan upgrade (limit raise)

messages.content: Can I upgrade to the pro plan? I need higher limit for withdrawals this quarter.
I can walk you through Pro and limit increases.

description: Upsell — loan against shares and insurance add-on

messages.content: Do you offer loan against shares? Also interested in insurance alongside my account.
We do — I can send eligibility and rates.

description: Retention — switch brokers over slow support

messages.content: This is unacceptable. I'm going to switch brokers if support stays this slow.
Understood — escalating to a senior specialist now.

description: None — AMC fee breakdown on statement (ops)

messages.content: What are the AMC fees shown on my mutual fund statement for June?
Those are fund-level charges — I'll email the breakdown.

description: None — feedback survey request

messages.content: Can I leave feedback about yesterday's support call?
Of course — I'll send a short survey link.

description: None — SIP debit date confirmation

messages.content: When does my SIP get debited each month? Just confirming the date.
Your SIP debit date is the 5th of every month.

description: Lead — KYC checklist and lowest brokerage plan

messages.content: How do I open a demat account? What documents are required for KYC, and what's your lowest brokerage plan?
I'll send the KYC checklist and our plan comparison right away.

description: Retention — high brokerage vs competitors

messages.content: Your brokerage is too high compared to others. Reduce my brokerage or I'll shift to another broker.
Let me check what rebate options I can offer you.

description: Upsell — F&O, margin, and family account

messages.content: Existing customer here — can you enable F&O and activate margin trading facility? Also want to add a family account for my wife.
Sure — I'll share the F&O activation and family account steps.

description: None — app crash, OTP, password reset

messages.content: The app keeps crashing and I didn't receive OTP to login. Please help reset my password.
I've triggered a password reset link and a fresh OTP to your registered number.

description: Lead — fintech wallet, card, and KYC to transact

messages.content: Hi, I'm new to your app. I want to open a wallet and apply for a credit card. How do I complete KYC to add money and start using UPI?
Welcome! I'll guide you through wallet setup, KYC, and card eligibility.

description: Retention — failed refund and delete account

messages.content: This is the worst — my refund failed weeks ago and no one helped. I want to delete my account and I'm switching to another app.
I'm really sorry — let me escalate the refund and see how we can keep you.

description: None — competitor UI comment without leave intent

messages.content: I saw your competitor has a nicer UI, just FYI.
Thanks for the note — I'll share it with product.
